page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on KVM virtualization. The instance is powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor based on the x86_64 architecture, configured with 6 physical cores and 12 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading enabled. It is equipped with 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a 35 MB L3 cache, alongside vector instruction support including AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI. The memory allocation totals 96.0 GB, providing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. No local instance storage is bundled, requiring the attachment of remote cloud disks, and no hardware GPUs are present. The instance includes a 4 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent mid-tier performance across multi-threaded and memory-centric workloads. In multi-core synthetic compute tests, the instance records 10,482.47 on stress-ng and 5,949.0 in Geekbench multi-core assessments, both landing in the middle 50% distribution. Memory subsystems achieve large-block read-only uncached bandwidth of 71.39 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 43.14 GB/sec, supporting a PassMark memory score of 2,415.67. Redis throughput reaches 10.13 million SET operations per second, and PassMark database operations register at 4,226.24. Conversely, single-thread compute metrics represent a noticeable performance constraint, with stress-ng single-core throughput (1,310.88) and single-threaded gzip compression (22.85 GB/sec) placing in the lower 25% bracket.

The qualitative efficiency of the ecs.r6.3xlarge centers on its dense memory allocation per CPU core, reducing overall compute provisioning overhead for memory-bound applications. The lack of integrated ephemeral storage necessitates reliance on network-attached storage, which places I/O dependency on the 4 Gbps network pipe. Given this resource distribution, the instance is appropriate for production Redis or Memcached clusters, medium-sized transactional databases, distributed caching nodes, and batch data transformation workloads where memory volume takes precedence over raw per-core CPU clock speeds.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.3xlarge is a memory-optimized server configuration featuring 12 dedicated vCPUs (6 physical cores) on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture and KVM virtualization, it pairs 96 GB of system memory with 4 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, yielding a high 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. The instance includes no local storage or discrete GPU accelerators. Benchmarks indicate balanced performance in memory-intensive operations, with Redis reaching 10.13 million SET operations per second and multi-core Geekbench scoring 5,949.0, though single-core compute tasks benchmark in lower performance quartiles. The configuration is suited for memory-intensive workloads, including in-memory data stores, relational databases, and enterprise application caching.
